g.text: Remove any one pillar and the other two collapse — governance without return has no reason to sustain participation; contribution without

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: governance has nothing to feed; and contribution with no return is a scoreboard.
